dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hey there, Bongo-Head, Kindlejoy! We're here to play with you! Don't worry, we'll have plenty more chances to just relax together like this in the future!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #What shall we do together with our Fungi friends, {NICKNAME}?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Same as always... Let's feed them, shall we?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Good idea! It seems like Haniyyah and Souka added a bunch of new Marvelous Jelly flavors based on their experiences. We can try feeding our buddies with them!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: We can... Make some gestures at them!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ooh, that's right! With the rapport we have with our Fungi friends now, we should be able to communicate using more complex gestures, right?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: We can even try out some more advanced signals now — y'know, those that require more specialized knowledge.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: We'll come back later and play with them then.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Well, Bongo-Head, Kindlejoy... See you later! Don'cha worry, we've got loads of time to play together in the future.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Use the Bulle Fruit-flavored jellies.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hmm, both of our Fungi friends like Bulle fruit, but their reactions are a lil' different!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Bongo-Head looks so content. Hehe, like it's about to drift off into the clouds after eating a delicious dessert...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Looks like Kindlejoy can handle sweets now, too! Hehe, it's all energized now, and it's sharp and cool, as always!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Use the Lakkaberry-flavored jellies.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh? How fascinating... The fruit-flavored jelly imported from Nod-Krai left our companions deep in thought.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Maybe the unfamiliar taste's sparked their imagination about what it's like there?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: If we can handle the invasive species problem the way we did in Fontaine, we might be able to take our Fungi friends out on a low-profile sightseeing trip.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Use the Coffee-flavored jellies.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Come to think of it, people usually use coffee to stay awake during overtime, right? Hmm. Do our Fungi friends have to work late too...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh? It seems like the taste of coffee has made our buddies even happier...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hmm... Maybe it's best if we don't associate coffee with work!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: If a little bit of coffee can help our Fungi friends keep playing without getting tired, that would be amazing!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Heh, let's just make sure they don't get carried away and exhaust themselves. That'll do it!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Act like you're snapping a photo with the Kamera.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh! So you mean we need to watch our timing when we take a picture? Hehe, Paimon's sure our Fungi friends can understand that now!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hehe, they reacted quickly, just as expected! At this rate, they'll be photography pros before we know it.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Hand to ear, a listening pose.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh, are you telling them to listen for any movement? Mm, yeah, that's definitely a vital skill when we're on the move.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: As expected of Bongo-Head and Kindlejoy! They settled down immediately, and it looks like they're feeling the vibrations through the earth with their little feet...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: The way we're working together now, Paimon would bet bottom Mora that we could be ready for danger long before it ever shows up!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Point at Paimon with your right hand, and pat your own head with your left hand.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hehe, Bongo-Head and Paimon remember this gesture! Bongo-Head's always happy to let Paimon pat its head.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Kindlejoy's reaction this time is...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Mm-hmm! Kindlejoy's learned not to jump onto Paimon's head too! Now that's what we call progress!
